descriptions.text: KnownOrigin officially tweeted that its discord had been attacked, and reminded users not to click on any links. Other servers hacked in recent days include those of Curiosity, Meta Hunters, Parallel, Goat Society, RFTP and Gooniez.

The Discord server for Known Origin, a fairly major NFT platform, was compromised. The scammer used their access to advertise a fake free NFT mint , which actually would steal NFTs if a user tried to connect their wallet. This is the latest in a long string of Discord compromises. Other hacked servers in recent days included those for Curiosities, Meta Hunters, Parallel, Goat Society, RFTP, and Gooniez.
